hypotheses.title: Ibuprofen extends Drosophila lifespan via prostaglandin synthesis inhibition
hypotheses.claim: Ibuprofen extends lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster by inhibiting cyclooxygenase-dependent prostaglandin synthesis. Reduced prostaglandin signaling will lower inflammatory-type signaling and thereby slow aging.
hypotheses.rationale: Prostaglandins promote oxidative stress and inflammatory signaling that accumulate with age. Blocking their synthesis should reduce this damage and extend survival.
hypotheses.prediction: Ibuprofen-treated flies will live significantly longer than controls, and the extension will be abolished by prostaglandin supplementation or in cyclooxygenase-deficient backgrounds.
hypotheses.experiment: Measure lifespan of flies fed ibuprofen versus vehicle, with parallel groups receiving prostaglandin rescue and genetic knockdown of cyclooxygenase to test mediation of the effect.

hypotheses.title: Ibuprofen extends lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster
hypotheses.claim: Ibuprofen extends lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster. Flies exposed to ibuprofen will show increased mean and maximum lifespan relative to untreated controls.
hypotheses.rationale: Ibuprofen modulates stress-response and inflammatory pathways conserved across species. Such modulation can reduce age-related cellular damage and prolong survival.
hypotheses.prediction: Flies fed ibuprofen will exhibit significantly longer mean and maximum lifespan than vehicle-fed controls under identical conditions.
hypotheses.experiment: Raise matched cohorts on food containing ibuprofen or vehicle and compare survivorship curves with full control of dose, density and environment.

hypotheses.title: Hydroxyprogesterone caproate extends lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster
hypotheses.claim: Hydroxyprogesterone caproate extends lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster. Flies receiving the compound will show increased mean and maximum lifespan relative to controls.
hypotheses.rationale: Progestin signaling influences metabolism, stress resistance and reproductive allocation, processes that govern aging rate. Adjusting this signaling can shift resources toward somatic maintenance.
hypotheses.prediction: Flies treated with hydroxyprogesterone caproate will exhibit significantly longer mean and maximum lifespan than vehicle-treated controls.
hypotheses.experiment: Compare survivorship of cohorts fed hydroxyprogesterone caproate versus vehicle across multiple doses, controlling for density, diet and sex.

hypotheses.title: Catechin extends Drosophila lifespan via insulin/IGF pathway activation
hypotheses.claim: Catechin extends lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster by activating the insulin/IGF signaling pathway. Pathway activation will trigger downstream programs that improve somatic maintenance and prolong life.
hypotheses.rationale: Insulin/IGF signaling regulates stress resistance, nutrient storage and aging rate through conserved transcriptional programs. Controlled activation of this pathway can enhance survival.
hypotheses.prediction: Catechin-fed flies will live longer than controls, and the extension will be lost when insulin/IGF signaling components are genetically inactivated.
hypotheses.experiment: Measure lifespan of catechin-treated versus control flies in wild-type and insulin/IGF pathway mutant backgrounds, monitoring pathway target expression.

hypotheses.title: Catechin shortens lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster
hypotheses.claim: Catechin shortens lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster. Flies exposed to catechin will show reduced mean and maximum lifespan relative to untreated controls.
hypotheses.rationale: Catechin can generate pro-oxidant effects at sufficient doses and perturb nutrient-sensing balance. Such perturbation may accelerate cellular damage and reduce survival.
hypotheses.prediction: Flies fed catechin will exhibit significantly shorter mean and maximum lifespan than vehicle-fed controls under identical conditions.
hypotheses.experiment: Raise matched cohorts on food containing catechin or vehicle and compare survivorship curves with full control of dose, density and environment.
